# Frontier Metals

> Frontier Metals manufactures metal roofing, wall panels, trim, structural building components, and complete steel building packages for agricultural, commercial, industrial, and residential projects. Serving West Texas, the Texas Panhandle, eastern New Mexico, western Oklahoma, and surrounding regional markets, with pickup and regional jobsite delivery.

## Panels

- [Panel Profiles](/panels): Overview of all metal panel profiles.
- [Pro-Rib Panel](/panels/pro-rib): Exposed-fastener structural rib panel, 36" coverage, 1-1/4" ribs on 12" centers, 24/26/29 gauge.
- [Standing Seam Panel](/panels/standing-seam): Concealed-fastener standing seam roofing, 16" coverage, 24/26 gauge.
- [Insulated Wall Panel](/panels/insulated-wall): Insulated sandwich wall panel, 40" coverage, 2"–4" thickness.

## Trims

- [Trims](/trims): Ridge, rake, eave, valley, corner, and base trim plus custom flashing. Individual trims are anchored on this page, e.g. /trims#ridge-cap.

## Products

- [Products](/products): Structural framing, fasteners, closures, and accessories we manufacture. Individual products are anchored on this page, e.g. /products#roof-purlins.
- Structural components: primary rigid frames, endwall frames, roof purlins, wall girts, eave struts, base angles.
- Fasteners and accessories: long-life panel screws, stitch screws, butyl sealant tape, silicone sealant, foam closure strips, ridge ventilation.
